{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently too low - true prices consistently exceed model predictions by 1-3 points in early periods and 3-5 points in later periods",
    "Lag effect: model fails to fully capture price momentum, especially during upward moves where there's a measurable delay in price acceleration",
    "Sentiment divergence: negative sentiment (-0.67) isn't reflected in lower forecasts, while positive sentiment (1.00) only modestly increases predictions",
    "Mean-reversion bias: model pulls prices toward historical means (67-68 range) when true prices are moving 70+ or below 65",
    "Forecast amplitude too small: true price swings are 20-30% larger than model-predicted variations",
    "Sentiment strength mismatch: high sentiment scores (1.00) only move prices 1-2 points but true prices move 3-5 points",
    "Early 30-day forecasts are consistently 2-3 points below true values while later forecasts converge"
] }
